title: Structured Payment in Pawnshop Borrowing: Mandates vs. Choice
abstract: arXiv:2608.13775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pawn loans offer borrowers a substantial degree of repayment flexibility in exchange for a harsh penalty in case of default: forfeit of collateral worth more than the loan amount along with any payments made toward recovery. Using a large RCT conducted in Mexico City, we document key stylized facts about pawn lending and explore the merits of replacing flexibility with structured repayment contracts in this important but understudied form of credit. Our experimental design includes a mandatory frequent-payments arm, a (status quo) flexible payments arm, and a choice between the two. This design point-identifies not only the average treatment effect, but also the effects of treatment on the treated and the untreated along with the average selection on gains, allowing a rigorous study of mandates versus choice. translated_title: 典当借款中的结构化还款：强制与选择
translated_abstract: 典当贷款为借款人提供了相当大的还款灵活性，但作为交换，若发生违约则面临严厉惩罚：失去价值超过贷款金额的抵押品以及已支付的任何追偿款项。通过在墨西哥城进行的一项大规模随机对照试验（RCT），我们记录了关于典当借贷的关键典型事实，并探讨了在这种重要但研究不足的信贷形式中，用结构化还款合同取代灵活性的优劣。我们的实验设计包括一个强制性频繁还款组、一个（现状的）灵活还款组，以及一个在两者之间进行选择的选择组。这一设计不仅识别了平均处理效应，还识别了处理对已处理和未处理个体的效应，以及基于收益的平均选择效应，从而允许对强制与选择进行严谨研究。尽管将借款人分配到结构化还款的平均处理效应是其财务成本降低19%，以及
tldr: 通过墨西哥城的大规模随机实验，研究发现强制结构化还款相比灵活还款能显著降低借款人的财务成本，且实验设计能精确识别强制与选择的效果差异。
en_tdlr: A large-scale RCT in Mexico City reveals that mandating structured repayment significantly reduces borrowers' financial costs compared to flexible options, precisely identifying effects of mandates versus choice.
